verdict.rationale: Each agent runs in its own cloud micro-VM rather than on the user's machine (maritime-docs-37), so local host secrets are out of reach by construction. Variables are encrypted at rest and injected only into that agent's VM (maritime-docs-33), and scoped keys limit what a leaked credential can do (maritime-docs-26, maritime-docs-44). However, nothing describes the sandbox's isolation guarantees, and injected secrets are by design readable by the code running in that VM. Missing for 10: explicit docs on VM isolation boundaries and what agent code cannot reach, a mechanism to keep credentials out of the agent's runtime (e.g. a proxy or broker), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
